How this document is organised
Part I – Questions (grouped by area and subtopic, Easy → Hard).
Part II – Answer key (compact grid).
Part III – Worked solutions.
About correctness
Every answer key was computed by program (exact fractions and integer arithmetic), and a large
share was cross-checked with SymPy symbolic computation or brute-force enumeration. Each
question has exactly four options and exactly one correct option, and the correct letter is randomised.
These questions are not yet reviewed by a human mathematician: spot-check a sample before
using them in reward-bearing or competitive play.
Limits of this edition
Questions are produced from parameterised templates (several different templates per subtopic), so
numbers vary but the problem types repeat within a subtopic. Per-option “why this distractor is
wrong” explanations, Amharic translations, and proof-evaluation items are not included. Difficulty is
relative to the educational level shown for each subtopic.
Difficulty guide: Easy ≈ 20–45 s · Medium ≈ 50–110 s · Hard ≈ 2–5 min.
